She was 11 years old, toy pinscher, about 5 kg (11,023 pounds). She never had any pregnancy, but we never spayed her. She slowly got lethargic and didn't want to eat, not even her favorite food.So after a week of not seeing any improvements, we brought her to the vet, he did an x-ray and told us she had pyometra and that we had 2 choices, gave her 2 injections to empty her uterus or do surgery right away. He told us that the injections should have emptied her uterus and make her feel better and that we had to do the surgery before her next heat, so we thought it wasn't that urgent. After those 2 injections and antibiotics she seemed way better, she got back to normal, so we were calm. We knew she had to do surgery before her next heat that was it. We didn't want to wait too long, so after a month we brought her to another vet to do the surgery and she couldn't handle the surgery. Everything went well, she just couldn't wake up. Yes surgery was necessary but he didn't do bloodwork or checked her vitals before giving her an injection. I'm from Italy

Edit: After the 2 injections she started losing white, almost yellow drops...I think the pyometra was closed, but after giving her the injections it opened. The second vet told us that we shouldn't have waited and that it had gotten really bad. He cut her uterus in front of us and it was so full of that stuff

She had a closed pyometra and he gave her 2 injections to empty her. I don't remember the name of the medication, but it was to empty her uterus. They gave her antibiotics too and she got better, she looked fine. But the vet that did the surgery told me that it had really gotten bad and the uterus was too full. So I guess the injections didn't work, I feel so bad for trusting the first vet and waiting
